signals.text: Had to send back. too small
Just wanted some new work shirts. It's a nice top. Longer in length which I like.

Made of a nice material. It isn’t too heavy, but it isn’t cheap and thin. Soft and very comfortable. Doesn’t wrinkle easily, which is nice.

The neck opening is a little large (wide). The shirt is a bit on the larger side. I chose an XL and think a smaller size would have worked. I am 5’4” and weigh about 171 lbs. I am a 38 DDD.
